description: This file is the main activity for an Android weather application, managing UI updates, user interactions, network requests for weather data, location services, and app updates. It contains methods for handling user input, fetching and displaying weather information, and managing permissions.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the weather app, handling UI updates, user interactions, location retrieval, weather data fetching, and app version updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI bindings, checks for updates, and initiates data fetching.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from speech recognition intent, updating the city input field and triggering weather data fetch.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the navigation bar color if the API level supports it.

methods.name: setUpDaysRecyclerView
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView for displaying daily weather forecasts.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets up various UI event listeners, including search, refresh, and voice input handlers.

methods.name: setRefreshLayoutColor
methods.description: Configures the refresh layout's color schemes.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Begins the process of searching weather data for a specified city.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves current location and fetches weather data based on network permissions.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Retrieves geographic coordinates for a city and initiates weather data fetch.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches and processes weather data for today for a given location or city.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI components with the latest weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates the day name for display purposes.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator and shows main content.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Shows the progress indicator and hides main content during loading.

methods.name: hideKeyboard
methods.description: Hides the soft keyboard for a given view.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity and prompts user accordingly.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks internet connection when activity resumes.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for available app updates and initiates immediate update if found.
